comment:
* The concrete route used by a connection to reach an abstract origin server. * When creating a connection the client has many options: *
    *
  • HTTP proxy: a proxy server may be explicitly * configured for the client. Otherwise the {@linkplain java.net.ProxySelector * proxy selector} is used. It may return multiple proxies to attempt. *
  • IP address: whether connecting directly to an origin * server or a proxy, opening a socket requires an IP address. The DNS * server may return multiple IP addresses to attempt. *
* Each route is a specific selection of these options. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public Proxy getProxy()
methods.comment: * Returns the {@link Proxy} of this route. * * Warning: This may disagree with {@link Address#getProxy} * when it is null. When the address's proxy is null, the proxy selector is * used.

methods.name: public boolean requiresTunnel()
methods.comment: * Returns true if this route tunnels HTTPS through an HTTP proxy. See RFC 2817, Section 5.2.
